type: actual owned Pod + actual Kubernetes pods/log + normal production UI

cases.name: Actual spec/status roles and app current log UI
Pause closes real HTTP, resume refetches tail, repeated open does not duplicate
Final current stream closes/aborts with panel, all request lifetimes end

limits: Only predefined synthetic fixture log markers are used; no real user logs or Secret payloads.
Restart is one controlled real exit42, not OOM.
Pause closes the actual HTTP stream; resume refetches the selected tail and does not guarantee gap retention.
No source/build/Git edits, tracing, mocking, camera/quality/DPR changes or performance claims.
resumeReason: One root-authorized targeted rerun after helper selected an old closed request while a new resume request was opening. Strict post-boundary request headers, observed received bytes and increased application line counters now distinguish the new stream. Close events are observed before browser context teardown; the old FAIL and missing-close observations remain unchanged.
